items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I kept him in the house two days... 'Hey, Baby Doll, give me 50¢.'

ctx.x: Why did that have an effect on him?

I don't know, I don't know why. I don't know if he was afraid of Monk or he respected him so much. So that's how I controlled him, through telling him I was going to get in touch with Monk. One time I held him here in the house and my brother got angry with me. I said, "I'm going to cure you of every thing you're doing." I kept him in the house two days and wouldn't allow him out. My brother came and said, "You shouldn't do that, because anything could happen to you." I said, "Not with him; he won't even steal…
